_about: What each pure biotype changes from the model's current values, as multipliers (or a percentage-point change for body fat): by eye (Rafael, 2026-11-08), to be edited. A mixed biotype is the weighted mean of its parts' values. current_body_fat_percent is the neutral bodies' fat share of the simulated body, by mass, from body_female_v10_foot-width and body_male_v4_foot-width. fat_changes_girths: how much of a body-fat change (as a share) reaches each girth.
